column1: Signal 8 Wallet: illustrative 13-week cash-flow scenarios
Units: mUSD, a fictional USD-denominated demo token. 1 mUSD is treated as approximately US$1, not HK$1.
How to use
Change only blue cells on Inputs. The two supplied scenarios remain side-by-side; neither is an exact runtime replay.
A: fixed-cost reference scenario. It shares selected FORECAST amounts, not its cash balance, payroll timing or cost implementation.
B: proposed fixed/variable costs and two-week headroom. These assumptions have not been adopted by the runtime or signed policy.
Forecast_A and Forecast_B compare no emergency funding with simulated cover plus credit. Credit creates debt, not revenue.
Summary shows week-end balances. Its remaining shortfall also checks opening cash; neither view establishes intra-week liquidity.
Credit draw sizing retained for comparison
The original pre-cost sizing formula is retained. It offsets cover against the projected minimum without respecting payout timing.
Remaining shortfall is now measured from actual modelled cash flows after costs, capped credit, payout timing and sweep.
Interest uses opening debt / 52 and is paid weekly. No interest is charged in the draw week. Opening debt is assumed zero.
Excluded: insurance premium, undrawn commitment fee, statutory employment costs and full monthly payroll payment timing.
A 10% gross-receipts sweep repays principal outside disrupted weeks. Credit may remain at week 13.
Source IDs are defined on Inputs. Scenario assumptions are not market quotations or regulatory approval.
The 16-day restaurant / 27-day small-business medians are from a 2016 US study using 2015 accounts, not current Hong Kong data.
Starting cash 20,000 is a scenario assumption. At 9,000 weekly outflows this corresponds to 15.6 days, not a validated shop reserve.
Fixed cost 6,300 and variable cost 27% remain unvalidated proposals. Payroll averages 23,000 x 12 / 52 = 5,307.69 weekly.
The 8% rate and 1% draw fee are illustrative. The HKMC ceiling cited is a dated 11 November 2024 snapshot, including relevant fees.
Negative cash represents an unmet funding requirement, not an approved overdraft. The 10,000 operating floor is a target, not a guarantee.
Chart: illustrative scenario B. It compares financing assumptions, not the isolated causal benefit of an AI wallet.
